ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with a ratio of approximately 95:5 dark-to-light, where light pixels are limited to distal barnacle clusters and scattered punctate spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark mass across >95% of the visible fluke; localized high-contrast (white) irregular geometric blobs at the distal tips; sparse white circular spots (diameter <10px) scattered across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 30 degrees, showing high-contrast separation between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the trailing edge, exhibiting an irregular sawtooth pattern with varying pixel depths of 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the upper edges of both lobes, tapering to highly irregular, textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular clusters of textured white pixels concentrated at the lateral distal tips of both lobes; scattered small-scale white clusters (possible barnacles) across the dark ventral field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular calcified masses (barnacle colonization) at the distal tips; trailing edge shows heavy non-uniform erosion/tearing patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive water-surface turbulence and spray create high-frequency white noise (pixel clusters) occluding the lower-central portion of the fluke-to-peduncle junction.
